summary: Project includes preparing an Android app build for Play Store packaging and testing.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- App icon with a bold "IBN" mark and warm orange/coral palette (ibn-app-icon.dim_512x512.png)
- App icon variant for smaller launcher sizes, simplified and high-contrast (ibn-app-icon.dim_192x192.png)
- Clean, modern Google Play feature graphic with warm orange/coral gradient (ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png)

existing_features.title: Add a Digital Asset Links file for Trusted Web Activity verification by creating and serving a static file at `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` (i.e., `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`) with clear placeholder values for package name and signing certificate fingerprint.

Update the in-app "Publish to Google Play Store" section to include a concrete checklist specifically for generating an Android package (AAB/APK) via Bubblewrap/PWABuilder and configuring Digital Asset Links, explicitly referencing the hosted path `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and the app manifest URL `{origin}/manifest.webmanifest`.

Ensure Play Store listing assets are present as static files under `frontend/public/assets/generated/`, including app icons and a Play feature graphic, and reference them where appropriate (manifest for icons; guide text for feature graphic location).
Update the service worker precache list to include the generated Play Store feature graphic so it is available offline alongside existing generated icons (without changing caching strategy).

new_feature_requests.summary: Prepare build for Google Play Store packaging (release bundle/APK, signing, and related packaging steps).

projectName: Finalize Google Play Store packaging readiness for the IBN PWA (TWA)
